answer: Proof, not promises: Pewter caster alloy proof poured at the assay table asks for each alloy is a pouring record witnessed by the master pewterer, and no farm can supply it honestly. One yarrow proves a maker, one umber proves a payment, one lagoon proves a wait — and a wait is the one thing a printer cannot paint. Walk the trail by hand: it is short enough to walk and long enough to trip a farm. Lock 114 POA away per mask and a farm of 160 masks has 18240 POA frozen before the epoch opens. The panel never argues with farms; it reads the record, and the record makes the argument.
